cutting_profiles.notes: Greg directed the 1115 trial insert through release and then explicitly corrected the model: 1105 and 1115 are completely different inserts even though their preceding designation segments are shared. He supplied the ISO 1832 and Sandvik suffix framework and asked that manufacturer designation conventions become the primary ingestion starting point. Exact Sandvik product payload values override generic examples where they differ.
